GOOGLE_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID (**Web application** type) for MCP sign-in. Guide: [onboarding-google.md](https://github.com/aryaminus/socials-assistant/blob/main/docs/onboarding-google.md). Skippable now — set later via `/setup`.

GOOGLE_LOGIN_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret for the same Google OAuth client. Skippable now — set later via `/setup`.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Any 64-char hex string — generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Encrypts platform tokens in D1. Rotating it later requires reconnecting platforms.

SOCIALS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: YouTube data app credentials — optional at deploy. The same Google client as sign-in works. Set later via `/setup`.

SOCIALS_META_APP_ID.description: Instagram + Facebook app — optional at deploy. Guide: [onboarding-meta.md](https://github.com/aryaminus/socials-assistant/blob/main/docs/onboarding-meta.md).

SOCIALS_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY.description: TikTok app — optional at deploy (approval takes days). Guide: [onboarding-tiktok.md](https://github.com/aryaminus/socials-assistant/blob/main/docs/onboarding-tiktok.md).
